title: 彩虹是怎么来的
subtitle: 阳光在水滴里拐了个弯
character: wearing a white t-shirt, green shorts and rubber boots, short black hair
style: children's picture book illustration in transparent watercolour, clean wet washes with soft edges, clear rainbow hues over plenty of white paper, light and airy

pages.zh:
雨刚停，
太阳就出来了。
我一转身，
天上挂着一条彩虹。
它是从哪儿冒出来的呢？
pages.scene: The little boy stands on wet ground in rubber boots, turning to look up at the sky, sunlight on his face.

pages.zh:
阳光看起来是白的，
其实里面藏着好多颜色。
红、橙、黄、绿、蓝、靛、紫，
一共七种。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one beam of white light entering a triangular glass prism on a white background and leaving as seven coloured stripes. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
光从空气跑进水里的时候，
会拐一个弯。
这叫「折射」。
每种颜色拐的角度
都不太一样。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one straight ray on a white background arriving at a flat water surface and bending as it enters, with the original direction shown as a faint dotted line. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
雨后的空中
飘着很多小水滴。
阳光钻进一颗小水滴，
在里面拐弯、反射，
再拐弯出来。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one large round water drop on a white background with a ray entering at the top left, bending, bouncing off the back wall, and leaving at the bottom left as several coloured rays. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
每颗水滴都在分光。
千千万万颗一起分，
我们就看见
一条弯弯的彩带。
pages.scene: Many small round drops spread across a white background, each with a tiny coloured fan under it. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
彩虹总是在太阳的对面。
所以要看见它，
得背对着太阳。
太阳在西边，
彩虹就在东边。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one sun on the left of a white background, one small figure in the middle facing right, and one rainbow arc on the right. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
彩虹其实是一个整圆。
只是地面挡住了下半圈，
所以我们
只看得见弯弯的一段。
pages.scene: One full circular rainbow ring on a white background with a horizontal ground line cutting across it, the part below the line drawn very faint. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
颜色的顺序不会变。
从外到里，
永远是红、橙、黄、绿、蓝、靛、紫。
红在最外面。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: seven nested arcs on a white background, the outermost red and the innermost violet. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
有时候能看见两条。
外面那条淡一些，
颜色还是反的：
紫在外，红在里。
那是光在水滴里多拐了一次。
pages.scene: Two rainbow arcs on a white background, one bright and one fainter above it, drawn simply. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
不下雨也能看见彩虹。
浇花的水雾里，
喷泉旁边，
甚至瀑布前面，
背对着太阳就能找到。
pages.scene: One garden hose spraying a fine mist on a white background with a small rainbow in the spray. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
自己也能做一条。
端一碗水放在窗边，
让阳光斜着照进去，
墙上就会出现
一条小小的彩虹。
pages.scene: One bowl of water on a windowsill on a white background with a small band of colours cast on the wall beside it. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
我背对着太阳站好，
彩虹正好在我前面。
红色在最外面，
紫色在最里面。
和书上说的一模一样。
pages.scene: The little boy stands with his back to the sun, looking ahead at a rainbow, arms at his sides, delighted.
